one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote compress.py that places ~330 shard directories directly under the output root (far exceeding the 30-items-per-directory limit), then verified only individual shard subdirectory counts (which correctly had 30 files) while never checking that the root itself exceeded the constraint.
t_err_evidence: compress.py written with flat output root structure, placing ~330 shard dirs directly under output root, violating 30-items-per-directory constraint
t_commit_evidence: Step 14: The agent runs 'python compress.py c4_sample test_output' which creates the violating structure (330 shard directories under the root). After execution, the failing layout is physically instantiated and the agent proceeds to validate subdirectory file counts rather than root item count, cementing the incorrect design.
trigger_explanation: The task specification says every directory must contain at most 30 items, which applies to all directories including the output root. The agent read only the per-shard (leaf directory) constraint and never considered that placing 330+ shard directories under the root would itself violate the same constraint. The spec requirement for root-level compliance was never incorporated into the design.
